Privacy Notice

OpenCord is self-hosted. The project maintainers do not receive third-party instance content by default.

Local storage

The instance operator stores account information, password hashes, session records, messages, memberships, moderation records, and uploaded files on the operator's own server. The main database is data/opencord.db and uploaded files are stored under uploads/.

Operator obligations

The instance operator is responsible for any legally required privacy notice, retention policy, security safeguards, user requests, and selection of infrastructure providers.

Voice and video

Voice, camera, and screen sharing use WebRTC. A configured TURN provider can relay encrypted WebRTC packets when a direct connection is unavailable and may process network metadata required to provide that relay.
